The Challenge

Data-Driven Trial Optimization

Clinical trials are the cornerstone of medical advancement, yet they remain notoriously slow, expensive, and unpredictable. Patient recruitment is a major bottleneck, and safety monitoring is often reactive rather than proactive.

Our Clinical Trial Analytics service uses AI and advanced analytics to optimize every phase of trial execution. We help you identify and enroll eligible patients faster, monitor safety and efficacy in real‑time, and predict trial outcomes with confidence.

We integrate data from EDC systems, EHRs, and patient registries to provide a unified view of trial performance. Our dashboards give you real‑time visibility into enrollment, data quality, and safety signals, enabling rapid decision‑making and protocol adjustments.

Accelerate your trials, reduce costs, and increase the probability of success — bringing life‑changing therapies to patients sooner.

Clinical Trial Analytics

Our Approach

Trial Data Integration & Harmonization

We aggregate data from EDC systems, EHRs, patient registries, and laboratory systems. We harmonize disparate data sources into a unified analytics platform that enables comprehensive trial oversight.

Patient Recruitment Optimization

We analyze electronic health records and patient databases to identify candidates who meet trial eligibility criteria. We predict patient enrollment likelihood and recommend outreach strategies to accelerate recruitment.

Real‑Time Safety & Efficacy Monitoring

We monitor adverse events, protocol deviations, and endpoint data in real‑time. We provide early warnings of safety signals and emerging efficacy trends, enabling rapid protocol adjustments.

Site Performance & Benchmarking

We compare site enrollment rates, data quality, and protocol adherence across all trial sites. We identify high‑performing sites and those requiring additional support or investigation.

Predictive Analytics for Trial Outcomes

We use machine learning to predict trial success probability based on interim data, historical benchmarks, and external factors. We provide probabilistic forecasts that guide go/no‑go decisions.

Data Quality & Completeness Monitoring

We track missing data, query rates, and data entry timelines. We identify data quality issues early and recommend corrective actions to ensure audit‑ready data.

What We Deliver

Trial Performance Dashboard

Real‑time view of enrollment, data quality, site performance, and safety metrics across all active trials.

Patient Recruitment & Enrollment Plan

AI‑generated list of eligible patients, with outreach recommendations and enrollment projections.

Safety & Efficacy Monitoring Report

Automated safety signal detection and interim efficacy analysis, with clear visualizations and alerts.

Site Scorecards & Benchmarking

Comparative analysis of site performance, identifying top‑performers and those needing support.

Trial Success Prediction

Probabilistic forecast of trial outcome based on interim data, with recommendations for protocol adjustments.

Regulatory Submission Readiness

Automated generation of DSMB reports, interim summaries, and data packages for regulatory bodies.

Core Capabilities

Patient Recruitment Dashboard

Visualize enrollment progress against targets, identify barriers, and track outreach effectiveness.

Safety Signal Detection

Automated alerts for adverse events and unanticipated safety signals. Ensure patient safety and regulatory compliance.

Site Performance Scorecards

Trial Success Prediction

Protocol Optimization Insights

Identify protocol elements that drive enrollment delays or high dropout rates. Recommend modifications.

Regulatory Reporting Automation

Generate DSMB reports, interim analyses, and regulatory submissions with pre‑built templates and automated data extraction.
